subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve active connections across runtime reloads

question: Should the stable runtime-owner fix land as this narrow PR, or should it be carried only by the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110754?
rationale: Both open maintainer-owned branches address the same runtime reload regression, but one intentionally isolates the production repair while the other also changes QA harness behavior; only maintainers can choose the preferred landing and review boundary.

options.title: Land the narrow runtime fix first
options.body: Merge this focused production repair after checks complete, then rebase the broader QA PR to retain only its account-aware harness changes.

options.title: Land the broader combined PR instead
options.body: Use the broader branch as the canonical fix only if maintainers want its QA-harness changes reviewed and landed with the runtime repair.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow runtime fix first
recommendation.body: Merge this focused production repair after checks complete, then rebase the broader QA PR to retain only its account-aware harness changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged context refactor and both current repair branches, giving them the clearest history of the intended split.
